study_identification_part.si4_title: Charting brain growth and aging at high spatial precision

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Assemble a large multi-site reference cohort and fit normative models of cortical thickness and subcortical volume across the lifespan; validate performance and demonstrate clinical utility by applying models to a transdiagnostic psychiatric sample and transfer to new sites.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: Multi-site aggregated dataset (82 sites); representative datasets include: ABCD; ABIDE; ADHD200; Cam-CAN; CMI-HBN; HCP-Aging; HCP-Development; HCP-Early Psychosis; HCP-Young Adult; IXI; NKI-RS; Oasis; OpenNeuro; PNC; SRPBS; UK Biobank; University of Michigan studies; UC Davis; University of Oslo; King's College London; Amsterdam UMC
rci1_dataset_name.reason: The paper explicitly states 82 sites were combined. The main text and supplementary files provide comprehensive lists of contributing datasets. Public datasets are clearly named (ABCD, ABIDE, etc.) and private datasets are identified by institution. Full details are in Supplementary files 1-2.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: Data from 82 sites were combined to create the initial full sample. These sites are described in detail in Supplementary files 1-2... Many sites were pulled from publicly available data sets including ABCD, ABIDE, ADHD200, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, IXI, NKI-RS, Oasis, OpenNeuro, PNC, SRPBS, and UKBiobank. ... Other included data come from studies conducted at the University of Michigan ... University of California Davis ... University of Oslo ... King's College London ... and Amsterdam University Medical Center

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Lifespan normative reference models of cortical thickness and subcortical volumes trained on 58,836 participants across 82 sites fit well and transfer to new sites; deviation maps reveal transdiagnostic heterogeneity and add information beyond standard case–control analyses.
